name: Houdini Block
summary: A craftable block that can be placed or broken without sending block updates to its neighbors. Four modes control whether suppression applies on break, on place, both, or when replacing blocks; useful for redstone contraptions and clean building.

new_content.name: Houdini Block
new_content.how_to_obtain: Shaped: DED / N#N / DED with D=diamond, E=eye of ender, N=nether star, #=stick
new_content.notes: Modes: Prevent on break, Prevent on place, Prevent all, Replace block (shown in tooltip).

editor_notes: How to switch modes is not stated in the README; verify in-game.
